notes.title: The air wall issue has been modified
notes.notes:
According to the feedback of many players, the place where the fence in rikuidan will go out of the map has been modified and an air wall has been added.

Thank you very much for downloading and playing, and I'm very sorry for the unpleasant game experience caused by personal negligence and insufficient ability



Description of other unsolvable problems:

1. About archiving: this game has not considered the issue of archiving when it is made (I simply won't do it). At present, it will be a bit troublesome to archive the game. If you want to archive the type of "save the progress of played", the file reading time will be very long, and it will consume a lot of memory and game time

2. Judgment bug caused by too fast operation: I won't change (sweat) due to my insufficient ability. I will try to learn more when I make games and have dialogue related interactions in the future

3. The game operation instructions need to be viewed on the start interface. The menu opened in the game is the "P" key. The operation and operation tutorial are still very immature at the time of production. Please understand



This game will not be updated after this update. Thank you for your attention, download and comments. Your suggestions are very valuable

Video of the whole process of the game (station B): [the complete process of the game] fantasy style personal game works of the book traveler: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1gB4y1q7fJ?share_source=copy_web&vd_source=732f164e0f74a522d499c8f3d8040d96



At present, we are planning to make new games and will strive to present better games in the future
